scripts.comment: the below command to run tests in headed mode with HTML report generation
scripts.test:qa:hd:report:html: cross-env ENV_NAME=qa SECRET_KEY=raja143 npx playwright test --project=chromium --headed
scripts.test:qa:ui-tests-headless:report:html: cross-env ENV_NAME=qa SECRET_KEY=raja143 npx playwright test --project=chromium --reporter=html --config=playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:qa:visualTesting: cross-env ENV_NAME=qa SECRET_KEY=raja143 npx playwright test --project=chromium --headed --grep=@VisualTesting
scripts.test:qa:infisicial: cross-env ENV_NAME=qa SECRET_KEY=raja143 npx playwright test tests/ui-tests/infisical_excel_testdata/testdataDrivenTest.spec.ts --project=chromium --headed --grep=@Infisicial
scripts.test:networkInterceptor: cross-env ENV_NAME=qa SECRET_KEY=raja143 npx playwright test tests/ui-tests/networkInterceptAndMocking/netWorkInterceptorAndMocking.spec.ts --project=chromium --headed --grep=@network
scripts.test:wiremock: cross-env ENV_NAME=qa SECRET_KEY=raja143 npx playwright test tests/ui-tests/serviceVirtualization/orangehrm-wiremock.spec.ts --project=chromium --headed --grep=@network
scripts.test:qa:api-testing: cross-env ENV_NAME=qa SECRET_KEY=raja143 npx playwright test --project=api-tests --reporter=html --config=playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:qa:lastfailed: cross-env ENV_NAME=qa SECRET_KEY=raja143 npx playwright test --project=chromium --headed --grep=@UI --last-failed
